notes.title: VIDEOVERSE - Update 1.2.0.3
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A small new update has released for VIDEOVERSE, which contains a whole new look for Kinmoku (that's me, not the in-game corporation!) plus some minor bug fixes. Please update so you have the latest version of the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/7d0626f21497e218867a54fd623d889c101bfa1d.gif[/img]

Inspired by the early roots of visual novels – from PC-98 to Sega Saturn – the new splash artwork features Kinmoku in their studio. If you look closely you can see references to Kinmoku's games, and even their dog, Goro!

Please keep a look out for more VIDEOVERSE news in the coming months! ːvideoverse_smileː

To learn more about the developer, please check out the new website at [url=https://www.kinmoku.games]www.kinmoku.games[/url]

notes.title: Update notes for VIDEOVERSE 1.2.0.2
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today's update fixes a bug at the end of chapter 1, where some players reported being unable to progress past Vivi's notification. It was a tricky one to fix but everything looks good now!

There have also been a few sprite and text fixes. The VIDEOVERSE demo has also been updated with these improvements.

Thanks again to those who reached out and helped fix the bug! You make VIDEOVERSE what it is :)

notes.title: Celebrate the first 'VIDEOVERSARY' with a new drawing update!
notes.content:
On [b]August 7[/b], it will have been one year since VIDEOVERSE launched on PC, Mac and Linux! Can you believe it? So much has happened in this year!

Firstly, VIDEOVERSE remains 'Very Positive' on Steam, with 90 on Metacritic and 92 on OpenCritic, which made it one of 2023’s highest-rated games! It also won 'Best Narrative' at Debug Indie Game Awards and 'Critics’ Choice Award' at Indie Cup UK, and was nominated for several other awards, including 'Safe in our World Award for Mental Health', 'Everyone Can Award for Accessibility' and 'Best Hidden Gem'. In such a competitive year, this was an incredible achievement for such a small indie game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/4710a99faf1fbeef3ae7bc593a71f7384c9cbdfb.png[/img]

So, to celebrate the first...[i]VIDEOVERSARY[/i], please enjoy [b]30% off[/b] during the PixElated Festival (July 29 - August 5) and the brand new Drawing Update (1.2), which contains the following features:

[h2]Gallery[/h2]
Now, you can collect all the drawings across Videoverse, plus CGs and cut-scenes! Please note: You'll need to start a new game to unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/943b44ccca6149abdb43ab52c5de8941cf1c7a80.png[/img]

[h2]Drawing Opportunities[/h2]
There are more opportunities to draw throughout the game via the Art Corner community. It's completely optional (for the artists amongst us!) but feel free to share your creations in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2079180]Steam community[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/8b49a47469c153a723581d1275354ec3316bfbda.png[/img]

[h2]Art and GUI Polish[/h2]
Artwork across the game has been polished, plus GUI has been improved in areas for smoother controller play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/04b33286a18466b171bba37a8501f59bb990740e.png[/img]

[h2]Faster Messages[/h2]
Due to popular demand, a new option ‘Faster Messages’ has been added in the Preferences menu. This speeds up private chat messages and is recommended for repeat play-throughs and achievement hunters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/e1ae5658dc71ec5663728e69fb1baa126c2ef461.png[/img]

Thank you all again for the continued support over the last year. VIDEOVERSE's community maybe small but it's the sweetest out there! I hope you enjoy the new update and are able to collect all the drawings...and please share your own drawings in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2079180]Steam community[/url]!

[h3][i]"Bye eMMe-T_T. Good luck with your drawings. :)"[/i][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/ecd8e686098d5765e7de4cdcc2cf905ee4dc7ac9.png[/img]

Hello everyone, happy 2024!

A few players reported that their save files broke when saving and loading in the Videoverse communities. This update also includes a few typo fixes, and the addition of sound effects to the drawing screen.

Thank you for being patient on this update and continuing to support VIDEOVERSE! :)

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE updated demo now available!
notes.content:
VIDEOVERSE's updated demo is now available to download for free! Like the first demo released in March, it contains the first chapter of the game, but with the following changes and improvements:

[list]
[*] More avatar customisation options
[*] Community updates
[*] New chat animations
[*] History log
[*] GUI improvements
[*] Other bug fixes
[/list]
If you played the March build and plan on continuing a save you started, there is a good chance you will run into crashes. I advise you to start afresh with this updated build instead.

I hope you all enjoy the first chapter of VIDEOVERSE and I look forward to hearing any feedback you may have. The demo will be available until the game fully launches - exact release date TBD but some time during Q3 2023!

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE Developer Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I just wanted to give you all a quick update about VIDEOVERSE's development.

Firstly, you may have noticed the updated screenshots on the store page. There are some new additions, showing the avatar creator and silly community drawings, plus the themes have been updated with their own unique graphics. I've also added GIFs to the description, showing more of the drawings and Emmett's favourite game, [i]Feudal Fantasy[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/301b4914cdd26e65d91c63b907111a555a4b64e6.gif[/img]

Feudal Fantasy is the Kinmoku Shark’s most popular JRPG, where Emmett meets other players in its exclusive Videoverse community. It's a clear nod to Final Fantasy, which was the game that lead me to making video games today! VIDEOVERSE is a story about inspiration, dreams and love…and, for me, that all started in the fan forums and chat rooms of my favourite video games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/96b3e3d822b93c54a6a66a50d86b1e1f4e1d3c63.gif[/img]

VIDEOVERSE itself is about to enter beta testing, meaning it's getting [b]very[/b] close to release. However, the release date is still TBD as I want to ensure there are no bugs or glitches when the game launches, so you can all experience the game as it's intended to be.

In the meantime, VIDEOVERSE will be at tomorrow's Indie Live Expo event! You can watch it live on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9EL_zK8Ylo]Youtube May 20th 7pm (JST) / 12pm (CEST)[/url]. Also, the next demo of VIDEOVERSE will soon be going live, too. Please keep an eye out for it in the next few weeks.

I thank you all for your patience and support as I finish this project that I started over three years ago. I cannot wait for you all to play it!

notes.title: VIDEOVERSE is taking part in The Storyteller’s Festival
notes.content:
Hello! I’m excited to announce that [b]VIDEOVERSE[/b] has been selected to take part in [b]The Storyteller’s Festival, from March 25th to April 1st[/b]. A free demo, containing chapter 1 of the game, will be available to download and experience during the event – I can’t wait for you all to play it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42816405/876da21b0c29efed831933f3b42683a705e14531.png[/img]

The VIDEOVERSE store page has also been updated with a gameplay trailer, new screenshots, description and GIFs, which divulge more information about what you do in the game. I hope you like what you see and I’d love to know your thoughts.

As for VIDEOVERSE itself, I’m happy to tell you that the following accessibility features have been added to the game:

[list]
[*] Closed captions
[*] Clear font option 
[*] A tip button, which can be used to conveniently find your solution without needing to quit the game and hunt online for one
[/list]

Plus, I’ve recently added more chat animations, characters and side quests so Videoverse continues to feel like a living, breathing community!

I'll soon be announcing the release date for the full game so stay tuned! Until then, please try out the demo available later this month on [b]March 25th[/b]. There will also be a broadcast event about VIDEOVERSE on [b]March 26th at 5:00 PM GMT/ 9:00 AM PST.[/b]
